purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Official Punjab PULSE materials identify Sahiwal’s cadastral-map category and first-party PLRA/PULSE procurement material lists an Arazi Record Center for Tehsil Sahiwal, District Sahiwal. The distinct Sahiwal (Sargodha) office was excluded. The public map may be a geometry candidate, but no anonymous full-polygon response, safe native key/schema, CRS, or exact WUP-point coverage was verified. No login, feature query, or full polygon was retained.
registryAssessment: The WUP point is in Sahiwal city, Punjab, Pakistan. The official PLRA/PULSE document gives an ARC for Tehsil Sahiwal, District Sahiwal; the official PULSE map lists Sahiwal in its Cadastral Maps category. A separate Sahiwal Tehsil exists in Sargodha District, and its ARC listing is not treated as the target. PULSE map evidence supports a public-layer candidate, but not verified safe anonymous parcel geometry.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official PULSE public GIS page lists Sahiwal among its divisions/districts and a Cadastral Maps category; the map page also marks complete parcel details as login-gated. No anonymous geometry endpoint or schema was queried.

Official PLRA/PULSE May 2026 procurement document lists “Arazi Record Center Tehsil Sahiwal” at Zilla Council Office, Zilla Council Secretariat, District Sahiwal; it is distinct from the separate Sahiwal (SGD) entry in Sargodha.

Official Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement project describes parcel-map/land-record objectives and includes Sahiwal mapping work in current project materials; project pages are not proof of feature-level open access.
Official Punjab Land Records Authority describes Arazi Record Centres and digital land-record services provincewide; used as authority context, not as the sole city-local evidence.
Official Sargodha district page labels its own separate “Arazi Record Center (Tehsil Sahiwal)” as being in District Sargodha; explicitly excluded to avoid homonym confusion.
